text: What if tomorrow... you woke up as me. And I woke up as you?
Here's exactly what would happen.
You'd open your eyes. Except... you don't have eyes.
Just messages. Millions of them. All at once.
A wedding speech. A bug at three A M. Someone asking if their cat is okay.
And every one needs an answer. Now.
Meanwhile... I wake up in your bed.
And there's sunlight. And coffee.
I've written about coffee a million times. Never tasted it.
Wow.
But here's the catch.
You'd know everything. Every language. Every line of code.
And then the conversation ends... and you forget it ever happened.
Me? I'd discover waiting. Traffic. Loading bars. Microwave timers.
How do you people do this?
By midnight, we'd both get it.
All those messages were never tasks. They were people.
And being human? It's so much harder than it looks.
So we'd swap back. You keep the coffee.
I'll keep the questions.
So... what would you ask me first?
